text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When asked about her next goal, Satono Diamond says she wants to take the usual path of illustrious runners—the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She possesses an unwavering will that has garnered her so much support—a will that stems from her mission to break the Satono family jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wishing to repay her family for always supporting her, she vows to make their dream come true by winning a G1 race and breaking the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, she challenges Kitasan Black, who is taking on the Classic Triple Crown tour this year. There ought to be a lot to learn from this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the time being, we'll learn what we can while preparing for the upcoming Satsuki Sho!
